# Center for Blockchain & Smart Contract Security

> A European resource hub for learning blockchain and smart contract security. Curated by Rey Olson, an information security specialist based in Belgium. Covers Ethereum, Solana, DeFi, bridge security, CBDCs, regulation, CTF challenges, and the Secureum bootcamp series.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/): Landing page with all articles listed by date.
- [About](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/about-2/): About the author, Rey Olson — information security specialist, Ethereum enthusiast, based in Belgium.
- [Services](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/security-audit-services/): The site does not offer audit services directly; refers visitors to Spearbit and Cantina for professional Web3 security.
- [Contact](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/contact/): Contact form / get in touch.
- [All Topics](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/): Full tag index.

## Resource Categories

- [Secureum](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/secureum/): Secureum bootcamp series for smart contract security auditing.
- [Capture The Flag](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/capture-the-flag-challenges/): CTF challenge resources.
- [Ethereum](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/ethereum/): Ethereum-focused security content.
- [Solana](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/solana/): Solana security resources.
- [DeFi](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/defi/): Decentralized finance security.
- [Bridge Security](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/bridges/): Cross-chain bridge security.
- [Regulation](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/legislation/): Cryptocurrency regulation articles.
- [CBDCs](https://smartcontractsecurity.eu/tags/cbdc/): Central Bank Digital Currency resources.
